pick.headline: Yeltsin's tanks shell the Russian parliament
pick.summary: On October 4, 1993, army tanks shelled the White House in Moscow, and the parliamentary leaders who had defied Boris Yeltsin, Ruslan Khasbulatov and Aleksandr Rutskoy, surrendered.
pick.significance: Washington backed Yeltsin. The crisis ended with a new constitution that concentrated power in the presidency.
